# PurePHP

> PurePHP is a PHP templating engine inspired by ReactJS functional components. It uses PHP objects to represent HTML elements, providing a declarative way to build user interfaces.

## Guide

- [What is PurePHP?](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/index.html.md): A progressive introduction to PurePHP, from immediate tag trees to compiled components and production artifacts.
- [Artifacts & Deployment](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/artifacts.html.md): Prerequisites : Compiled Rendering, Components; On this page : pure compile artifacts, the pure check contract check, plain views and deployment caching.
- [Basic Usage](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/basic-usage.html.md): Prerequisites : Quick Start; On this page : the tag API — creating elements, setting attributes, immediate rendering.
- [Compiled Rendering](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/compiled.html.md): Prerequisites : Components; On this page : how a component's template compiles, the runtime cache and performance.
- [Components](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/components.html.md): Prerequisites : Props and Slots; On this page : wrapping shapes with components — call functions, templates and typed props.
- [Core Concepts](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/concepts.html.md): Prerequisites : Quick Start; On this page : tag trees, shapes, slots, components and data scope.
- [Events](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/events.html.md): Prerequisites : Basic Usage; On this page : accessible browser events, event delegation and CSP-safe listener setup.
- [Examples](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/examples.html.md): Run the PurePHP bootstrap, event-counter, and XML examples, including strict, plain, and cover routes.
- [Quick Start](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/getting-started.html.md): Prerequisites : PHP 8.1+, Composer; On this page : install PurePHP, run a component directly, and wire the same component into a real front controller.
- [PurePHP with HTMX](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/htmx.html.md): Prerequisites : Components; On this page : server-rendered fragments, routing, and safe state changes with HTMX.
- [Props and Slots](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/props.html.md): Prerequisites : Core Concepts; On this page : slot types, modifiers and the data-binding reference.
- [SVG and XML Support](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/svg-xml.html.md): Prerequisites : Basic Usage; On this page : building SVG graphics and XML documents, and compiling them for export.
- [PurePHP with Tailwind CSS](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/tailwindcss.html.md): Prerequisites : Components; On this page : a pinned Tailwind CSS v4 build and accessible component examples.
- [Troubleshooting](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/troubleshooting.html.md): Symptom-based fixes for installation, slots, components, artifacts, caching, and examples.
- [Upgrading](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/upgrading.html.md): Requirements, upgrade steps, and rollback for PurePHP.
- [Utility Functions](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/guide/utils.html.md): Prerequisites : Core Concepts; On this page : clx(), sty() and renderHTML() / renderXML().

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/index.html.md): The public rendering and component entry points. Each page lists what is public API and what is marked @internal; the Component API covers the component surface.
- [Compile API](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/compile.html.md): Pure\Compile\Compile compiles a data-free shape tree into a flat PHP renderer.
- [Component API](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/component.html.md): Public PurePHP component helpers, Call behavior, registry boundaries, contract attributes, Template, and PHPStan integration.
- [HTML Class](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/html.html.md): Pure\Core\HTML extends the Tag class, specifically for HTML tags.
- [Raw Class](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/raw.html.md): Pure\Core\Raw represents trusted markup that is emitted verbatim instead of being escaped. It is a trust boundary, not a sanitizer.
- [SVG Class](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/svg.html.md): Pure\Core\SVG extends Pure\Core\XML for SVG tags. It chooses self-closing rendering for selected childless elements, but it does not add an SVG namespace automatically.
- [Tag Class](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/tag.html.md): Pure\Core\Tag is the base abstract class for all HTML, XML and SVG tags.
- [XML Class](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/api/xml.html.md): Pure\Core\XML extends the Tag class for creating XML elements.

## 中文指南 (Chinese Guide)

- [什么是 PurePHP？](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/index.html.md): 从即时标签树到编译组件与生产产物的 PurePHP 渐进式入门路径。

- [基础用法](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/basic-usage.html.md): 前置 ：快速开始； 本页 ：标签 API——创建元素、设置属性与即时渲染。
- [编译渲染](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/compiled.html.md): 前置 ：组件； 本页 ：组件模板的编译、运行时缓存与性能。
- [组件](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/components.html.md): 前置 ：Props 与 Slot； 本页 ：用 Component 包装 Shape——调用函数、模板与类型化 props。
- [核心概念](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/concepts.html.md): 前置 ：快速开始； 本页 ：Tag 树、Shape、Slot、组件与数据作用域。
- [事件](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/events.html.md): 前置 ：基本用法； 本页 ：无障碍浏览器事件、事件委托与符合 CSP 的监听器设置。
- [示例](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/examples.html.md): 运行 PurePHP 的 bootstrap、event-counter 与 XML 示例，比较严格产物、plain 视图和静态 cover 路由。
- [快速开始](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/getting-started.html.md): 前置 ：PHP 8.1+、Composer； 本页 ：安装 PurePHP，直接运行组件，并把同一组件接入真实应用入口。
- [PurePHP 与 HTMX 集成](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/htmx.html.md): 前置 ：组件； 本页 ：用服务端 fragment、路由和安全状态变更实现 HTMX 交互。
- [Props 与 Slot](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/props.html.md): 前置 ：核心概念； 本页 ：Slot 类型、修饰符与数据绑定参考。
- [SVG 和 XML 支持](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/svg-xml.html.md): 前置 ：基本用法； 本页 ：SVG 图形与 XML 文档的构建和编译导出。
- [PurePHP 与 Tailwind CSS 集成](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/tailwindcss.html.md): 前置 ：组件； 本页 ：锁定 Tailwind CSS v4 版本并编写可访问的组件示例。
- [故障排查](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/troubleshooting.html.md): 按症状排查安装、Slot、组件、产物、缓存和示例问题。
- [升级](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/upgrading.html.md): PurePHP 的环境要求、升级步骤与回滚说明。
- [工具函数](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/guide/utils.html.md): 前置 ：核心概念； 本页 ：clx()、sty() 与 renderHTML() / renderXML()。

## 中文 API 参考 (Chinese API Reference)

- [API 参考](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/index.html.md): 公共渲染与组件入口。各页都会说明哪些是公共 API、哪些标记为 @internal； 组件接口见 Component API。
- [Compile API](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/compile.html.md): Pure\Compile\Compile 把一棵不含数据的 Shape 树编译成扁平的 PHP 渲染器。 静态标记在编译期一次性转义，并作为字面量字符串块输出，因此渲染一个页面只比字符串拼接加上动态值转义略多一点开销。
- [组件 API](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/component.html.md): PurePHP 组件公共入口、Call 行为、Registry 边界、契约属性、Template 与 PHPStan 集成。
- [HTML 类](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/html.html.md): Pure\Core\HTML 继承自 Tag 类，专门用于 HTML 标签。
- [Raw 类](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/raw.html.md): Pure\Core\Raw 表示可信标记，会按原样输出，不会被转义。它是信任边界，不是清理器。
- [SVG 类](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/svg.html.md): Pure\Core\SVG 继承 Pure\Core\XML，用于 SVG 标签。它会为选定的无子节点元素 选择自闭合渲染风格，但不会自动添加 SVG 命名空间。
- [Tag 类](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/tag.html.md): Pure\Core\Tag 是所有 HTML、XML 和 SVG 标签的基础抽象类。
- [XML 类](https://yonld.github.io/purephp/zh/api/xml.html.md): Pure\Core\XML 继承自 Tag 类，用于创建 XML 元素。
